verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing page says it supports replication configurations alongside single-server setups. Separate claims list Kubernetes compatibility and distributed-capable databases such as TiDB, PostgreSQL and MySQL. These are single-sentence vendor claims with no documented HA architecture, failover behavior or setup guide, and no hands-on reports of a replicated deployment. missing for 10: explicit high-availability/failover documentation, guidance for shared storage and session/queue/cache setup across nodes, a step-by-step replicated deployment guide, independent hands-on corroboration of a multi-node HA install.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy a self-hosted instance in a replicated, highly available configuration

citations.quote: Provides flexible deployment options, supporting both single server setups and replication configurations.
Universally compatible with diverse operating systems and environments, including Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, and Kubernetes.
Offers seamless integration with leading databases, including SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB, and MS SQL.
